title: AI-Powered Math Teaching Assistant - Process-level Feedback & Assessment
summary: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of CherryPot use across Korean schools. The account provides no effect size or independent outcome evaluation.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of CherryPot use across Korean schools and describes plans to expand deployment. The account provides no effect size or independent outcome evaluation.
purpose: Provide process-level math feedback and automate grading.

ratings.reason: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of use. The account provides no effect size or independent outcome evaluation.
The deployed platform automates grading and process-level feedback, which the provider presents as reducing teachers' routine work. The time saving is unquantified.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
